sourceAssignments.summary: Reviewed the exact Current Connected Vue Gen 3 page and the linked Emporia Vue 3 technical sell sheet. The exact captured Current Connected offers distinguish SKU EMV3A-2P-16 / Sixteen from EMV3A-2P-8 / Eight. The seller's page supports the 2×200 A main-CT and 8/16×50 A branch-CT package distinction; the manufacturer sheet supports device capacity of 3 voltage channels, up to 3×200 A main CT channels and up to 16×50 A branch CT channels, the 264 VAC line-to-neutral maximum sensing voltage per voltage channel, Wi-Fi/Ethernet, and ±2% accuracy. Do not treat included CT counts as device channel capacity, do not sum current ratings across CTs, and do not transfer branch-sensor count into maximum capability. Batch 34's review of the same EMV3-A technical sheet corrected Channels and Communications aliases and accepted ±2%; it separately held the retailer's two-main/eight-branch included-package row as not equivalent to device channel capacity. I followed that distinction: package counts are recorded as exact variant identity/source context, while the reviewed Channels value is the manufacturer's maximum device capacity. The source states ±2% but does not give measurement conditions. No IP code was found; indoor/dry operating conditions are not an IP rating. No generic Emporia Vue sibling facts or identity anchors were transferred.
